gold_sql:
WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT p.id, p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  WHERE ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.98756 40.744668)',4326)::geography, 3000)
    AND p.amenity = 'cafe'
),
poi_elev AS (
  SELECT c.id, elev.z
  FROM candidates c
  JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, c.geometry::geometry) AS z
    FROM public.dem_us d
    WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, c.geometry::geometry)
    LIMIT 1
  ) elev ON elev.z IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count
FROM poi_elev
WHERE z <= 420;

WITH target_cafe AS (
  SELECT geometry
  FROM pois
  WHERE poi_name ILIKE 'Think Coffee'
    AND addr_city = 'New York'
    AND addr_state = 'NY'
    AND amenity = 'cafe'
    AND id = 27827
),
buffered_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(geometry::geometry, 3000) AS geom
  FROM target_cafe
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(rast, true, geom) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us, buffered_area
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, geom)
),
cafes_in_buffer AS (
  SELECT p.id
  FROM pois p, buffered_area b
  WHERE p.amenity = 'cafe'
    AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geometry, b.geom, 0)
    AND p.id != 27827 -- exclude the target cafe itself
),
elevations AS (
  SELECT c.id,
         ST_Value(cd.rast, p.geometry::geometry) AS elevation
  FROM cafes_in_buffer c
  JOIN pois p ON p.id = c.id
  JOIN clipped_dem cd ON ST_Intersects(cd.rast, p.geometry::geometry)
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS cafe_count
FROM elevations
WHERE elevation < 420;
